title: Origin story: Merlin
description: Merlin was the son of a demon and a mortal woman, the prophet-wizard who engineered Arthur's conception and guided his reign. He foresaw all but his own doom — the enchantress Nimue learned his secrets and sealed him in a crystal cave or under a stone, where some say he sleeps still.

title: Power ranking: Merlin
description: Powers: Sight across all time; The magic that built Camelot; The wild's own ancient power.

title: Stamina feats: Merlin
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Guided kings for generations; Endures sealed, in some tales, to this day.
